lines: Active rows: native Rust/Bevy server, persistence, toolchain, delivery, reference baseline and project status.
F- IDs form one space across `docs/ledgers/findings/`; retired rows keep their
full text under `retired/`. Admission and columns follow `.agents/rules/docs.md`.
F-968 is retired in favor of F-1175.
| ID | Claim | Kind | Evidence | Scope and limits | Unknowns | Status |

fields.claim: Native config validates with CLI overrides and no-write inspection; a fixed-step ECS loop keeps stable authored IDs, coherent snapshot capture and bounded catch-up with counters; its 30 Hz development tick rate is provisional, not an ICARUS property
fields.scope_and_limits: high; native config and loop

fields.claim: Native persistence (snapshot v1, not the ICARUS format): one async save at a time, writer lock, checksummed generations, atomic manifest, two-generation recovery; stale snapshots never publish, save-worker loss stops simulation, SIGINT/SIGTERM save and stop by deadline (N-004)
fields.scope_and_limits: high; native; no OS-write preemption

fields.claim: No official server bugs are marked reproduced or fixed.
fields.scope_and_limits: high; bug ledger state

fields.claim: October 4 authorization/checkpoint documents record historical research batches; the overnight runtime window has expired.
fields.scope_and_limits: high; authorization records

fields.claim: Unsupported schemas and missing/corrupt manifests fail closed. import-save checks migrated enums and retained C016 positions (F-651), counts qualified slots and refuses publication without touching the destination
fields.scope_and_limits: high; authored cases and one dense supplied list; owner binding open

fields.claim: Synthetic 100,000-entity runs keep exact state and no missed ticks: a historical 7,200 s soak (719 saves) and a 120 s run (60 saves, 28,924 KiB peak RSS); the object-gated store passes 22 generations; 24 kill cycles keep acked ticks
fields.evidence: runtime-capture; M-132..M-137, M-212, M-213, M-218; cac76ec
fields.scope_and_limits: high; synthetic; soak predates later store changes

fields.claim: Real FS probe passes ENOSPC/EACCES with unchanged acknowledged state, restoration, retries and reopen; N-003 fixed error classification via typed I/O kind.
fields.scope_and_limits: high; 256 KiB unprivileged tmpfs, gen 4/tick 40, 1,100 entities; Historical failed run preserved

fields.claim: Native store reads fail closed: manifest digests must be canonical hex before rollback or fallback; positional metadata/entity arrays are rejected (future objects refuse rollback); non-NotFound read errors (EACCES once deleted tick 20) do not roll back
fields.scope_and_limits: high; authored native state; no manifest auth

fields.claim: User reports local client/save pair compatible; historical access deferral superseded by F-1175
fields.scope_and_limits: medium; local client/save pair; no runtime/build-pair proof; producing save build unconfirmed; offline work continues

fields.claim: User decisions (2026-10-22): the native server must work without the game client (not public) or data derived only from it; basic data it needs may come from the free public dedicated server, fetched unattended at install time, preferably by its own Rust fetcher instead of steamcmd
fields.scope_and_limits: high; scope decision

fields.claim: The pinned dedicated server 25956137 ships its data tables as 299 JSON members of an unencrypted pak v11, Icarus/Content/Data/data.pak (2.5 MB; session flags, stats, items, seeds, modifiers, quests, missions, prospects among them); DefaultGameplayTags.ini and D_Tags in its content paks
fields.scope_and_limits: high; index listing, contents unread

fields.claim: The native icarus-fetch downloads the official dedicated server's data.pak anonymously from Steam without steamcmd (app 2089300, depot 2089301, build 25956137; 3 chunks, about 2 s), byte-identical by SHA-256 to the steamcmd-installed copy
fields.scope_and_limits: high; one file, one build

fields.claim: Eight native JSON cases disclosed supplied strings/keys through Serde causes; shared stage/category/location diagnostics now drop causes at all 3 decode boundaries
fields.scope_and_limits: high; authored API/CLI; preserves unsupported schema, recovery and raw I/O causes; no private inputs

fields.claim: Native snapshot capture visits every domain-identified entity and rejects missing required components before publication; the earlier query silently omitted them (three regressions reproduce it, four cover the fix); entities lacking domain identity are not captured
fields.scope_and_limits: high; no original runtime, save parsing or ICARUS test

fields.claim: 72 h synthetic schedule, 100,000 entities at 30 Hz: the wall-clock run stopped at 78,964 s (7,882 saves, p99 160 ms; 2 missed ticks, 71 clamps; peak RSS 28,708 KiB); compressed, 7,776,000 ticks and 25,921 saves took 3,028 s (save p99 88 ms, RSS -38.5 KiB/h, one tick over)

fields.claim: Client 25793767 and server 25621760 PE/PDB pairs match GUID/age and section headers; PEs unsigned (Security Dir 0); REA direct PE reads cap at 64 MiB
fields.scope_and_limits: high; local debug identity, not authenticity, runtime access or save build

fields.claim: The project is an independent native foundation, not an ICARUS-compatible server: protocol, authentication, replication, gameplay, world-data parity, official-save import and migration are undemonstrated; no ICARUS performance or stability gain is measured
fields.scope_and_limits: high; whole project; absence of proof only; one stateless exchange (F-253)

fields.claim: REA 6.4.0 `export_evidence_bundle` writes Evidence IDs at `records[].evidence_id` and residual unknowns at `unknowns[].unknown_id`; the lint's bundle-membership check depends on this layout
fields.scope_and_limits: high; one authored fixture, 3 records, 1 unknown; other REA versions unverified

fields.claim: The CI definition (formatting, Clippy, Rust tests, full manual prek suite, locked release build, headless smoke) passes on hosted ubuntu-24.04 for feature commit a3f1265

fields.claim: Power-loss model of the real write path (65 traced effects): 2,536 crash points, 5,720 POSIX crash states all recover the latest acknowledged or a newer saved generation; a crash before the first manifest refuses with manual recovery; stranded temporaries leaked until fixed
fields.scope_and_limits: high; modeled POSIX, not hardware; data whole/empty/half

fields.claim: PR policy: at most 250 commits, every non-merge commit signed off by its author; squash merges only. A user-approved message-only rewrite signed the 35 old commits, keeping trees; PR #3 passed at 248. Pre-rewrite SHAs resolve via tag `archive/native-server-foundation-pre-signoff`
fields.scope_and_limits: high; settings as configured

fields.claim: Bevy loopback peer lab adds a peer only after a handshake ack (capped, idle expiry, one ack per update, bad datagrams rejected); mismatched Hello gets Upgrade, empty-token Hello Challenge, Login Failure then removal, resent reliably; that lab sent no Welcome (cf. F-1009)
fields.scope_and_limits: high; loopback; inferred mirror

fields.claim: Schema 3 keeps each supplied copy whole in a write-once content-addressed sidecar (21.4 MB) referenced by 297-byte generations: later saves 18 ms, load 140 ms, 196 MB peak RSS; modeled power loss over sidecar write, reuse, loss and migration keeps acknowledged state
fields.evidence: structural-comparison; M-397 to M-399, M-414 to M-416
fields.scope_and_limits: high; two copies; modeled POSIX

fields.claim: Seeded preserved worlds pass 10 s autosaves with no failure or miss: 180 in 30 min, 120 each for two at once, 25,920 in 72 compressed hours (17.5 min, save p99 59 ms, RSS ~27.8 MB, clean reload); streamed verify: 27.6 MB per world

fields.claim: Fixed-seed randomized checks never panic: 120,000 bit strings (property/actor readers), 4,000 + 6,000 preservation inputs, 40,000 datagrams + 40,000 control bodies, 3,000 loopback datagrams, 1,500 corrupted stores; accepted inputs re-encode or reload exactly
fields.scope_and_limits: high; fixed seed

fields.claim: Weekly builds change server code and content (25621760 -> 25793607 -> 25956137): 3.0.32 shrinks .text 48,128 B and .pdata 1,920 B, changes 15 of 435 files (EXEs, PDB, version.json, D_Data.pak, 7 content paks, 3 string tables) and moves the checksum to 243431684

fields.claim: Opt-in loopback [network] in run checks a release_profile pin, binds before world state, answers mismatched Hello with Upgrade, admits probes to Join up to max_players, evicts idle sessions, closes all before the final save; 1,000 and 200 (binary) join/close cycles leave 0 peers
fields.scope_and_limits: high; authored probe; no ICARUS client

fields.claim: Full-path loopback churn (Join to record ACK; close, idle expiry, same-address reconnect, leave after Join/Begin/profiles; 8 concurrent; observer; production bind): 1,000 sessions each keep PeerLab and GUID-cache sizes at warm-up
fields.scope_and_limits: high; authored probe; counts, no RSS; fixed 18 keyed GUIDs kept per session; GUIDs not reused

fields.claim: run closes per F-782: at teardown each session gets Failure "Host closed the connection." in its own datagram, then a reason-0 control close once it has sent a reliable bunch; a PlayerController channel failure (F-757) closes the peer; stage closes (3, 4) send close bunches
fields.scope_and_limits: high; loopback probe; no ICARUS client

fields.claim: run answers Join with PlayerController (2, F-852), pawn (3, F-854), GameState (4, F-794; saved prospect, game mode values and level clock, F-855) and PlayerState (5, F-784) opens; exports until acked (F-796), resent on nak. World opens follow F-1262

fields.claim: Empty: 1 peer 1/8 h, 8 peers 1/10.1/12 h. Seed: 8 peers, 64 actors, 180 s, 16k updates, 269 ms max gap. Two reopens +1 tick. Pre-close-fix overlap 205 s; stderr forecast 43.7 MB > 32 MiB
